snippet.title: Staged – Offical Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
The curtain is rising! Staged launches on September 2, 2026! 🎭

Step into the spotlight with up to four mischievous goblins in this chaotic 3D co-op party game. Work together to build stage sets, recreate classic European stories, complete creative minigames, and survive unexpected backstage mayhem.

Play together online, via LAN, or locally on the couch. Every performance tests your teamwork, communication, and timing, and no two shows feel quite the same.

Watch the Release Date Reveal Trailer and get ready for Staged on September 2, 2026!

Wishlist Staged on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3534100/Staged/
